Judgment estimates, not measured win rates. No public dataset gives per-program win rates for an org of this profile.
On the 10-15% figure: a fair average across all grantseeking, but applied uniformly it misdirects effort. Real odds here span ~50% down to low single digits, running close to INVERSE to award size.

Seven factors behind each estimate: eligibility certainty; geographic restriction (the biggest lever); award-to-budget ratio; competitive pool; track-record requirements; application burden; mission fit.

Federal cash-flow risk: most federal grants reimburse after spending. A $300k org winning $1M on cost-reimbursement must front payroll for months. Winning #15/#16 without a credit line could be worse than losing them.
